paper.title: Differential Privacy in Kernelized Contextual Bandits via Random Projections

settings.name_in_paper: Private contextual kernel bandits with stochastic contexts under Joint Differential Privacy (JDP)
unmapped: (eps_DP, delta_DP)-joint differential privacy of the action sequence w.r.t. context-reward pairs
learner has access to a generator of i.i.d. contexts from the context distribution (Assumption 2.5), without knowing the distribution
finite context set and finite action set; the learner knows |W| = |C x X| (used in confidence widths)
learner knows the regularization/fictitious noise variance tau and delta_DP
settings.definition_quote: at each time instant t, the agent is presented with a context c_t \in \cC, which is drawn i.i.d. from a context distribution \kappa. Based on the context, the agent takes an action x_t \in \cX and observes y_t, a noisy value of the reward f(c_t,x_t). ... the reward function f belongs to an RKHS \cH_k corresponding to a known kernel k ... and satisfies \|f\|_{\cH_k} \leq B. ... The rewards are bounded in absolute value, |y_t|<B

learner knows the regularization/fictitious noise variance tau and delta_DP
